description:

India

**Purpose of the Job**
----------------------

We are looking for a hands-on Full Stack Developer who can build and own modern, scalable web applications end-to-end. The role requires strong expertise

across React, Next.js and TypeScript, solid database and SQL fundamentals, and working proficiency in Python.

You will work in an AI-native engineering environment where tools such as Cursor are part of the development workflow. We are looking for an engineer who combines delivery speed with disciplined engineering practices, including automated testing, meaningful code coverage, maintainable architecture, peer review, and consistently high code-quality standards.

You will collaborate closely with Product, Design, Data and AI Engineering teams to

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Build and maintain scalable full-stack applications using React/Next.js, TypeScript , Node.js/Nest.js and Python.

* Develop reusable UI components, backend APIs and database-driven features.

* Write efficient SQL queries and ensure sound database design and performance.

* Own features end-to-end, from technical design and development to testing and production deployment.

* Use AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor to improve development speed and productivity.

* Write clean, maintainable and testable code with strong unit/integration testing and code coverage.

* Maintain high engineering standards through code reviews, refactoring and coding best practices.

* Troubleshoot production issues and continuously improve application performance and reliability.

* Collaborate with Product, Design, Data and AI teams to deliver business requirements.

* Contribute to AI-enabled solutions involving RAG, AI workflows, multimodal and Agentic AI where applicable.

**Qualifications Requirement: Experience, Skills & Education:**
---------------------------------------------------------------

* B.Tech / M.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. Equivalent hands-on software engineering experience will also be considered.

* 5+ years of hands-on experience building and shipping production-grade full stack applications.

* Hands-on programming experience in Node.js/Nest.js / Python for backend services, APIs, automation or application workflows.

* Strong hands-on expertise in React/Next.js and TypeScript, including component design, state management, routing, rendering patterns and frontend performance.

* Strong database fundamentals and SQL skills, including schema design, complex queries, joins, indexing, transactions and performance optimization.

* Practical experience using AI development tools such as Cursor as part of day-to-day software engineering.

* Demonstrated ownership of software quality in previous organizations, including automated testing, code coverage, peer code reviews and maintainable coding standards.

* Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, Git-based development workflows, CI/CD practices and production debugging.

* Strong problem-solving ability, product mindset and ownership from design through production.

**Good to Have**
----------------

* Hands-on exposure to AI workflows and LLM-powered application development.

* Experience building or integrating Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including embeddings, retrieval, re-ranking or vector databases.

* Exposure to multimodal AI experiences involving text, image, voice or video.

* Experience with agentic AI or multi-agent workflows, including tool calling and orchestration frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph.

  

**Apply for This Position**
---------------------------

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. **Job title : Agentic AI – Application Developer (.NET) - Senior**

  

**The opportunity**

  

We’re looking for **Senior** with expertise in **full-stack application development** using **.NET, C#** for **Agentic AI applications** to join the TTT team in the Tax Service Line. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a pioneering firm while playing an instrumental role in the growth of Agentic AI transformation.

**Your key responsibilities**

  

* Design, develop, and implement AI agents/plugins/interfaces and APIs, ensuring integration with various systems aligns with the core product/ platform development strategy.
* Estimate and manage technical efforts, including work breakdown structures, risks, and solutions, while adhering to development methodologies and KPIs.
* Maintain effective communication within the team and with stakeholders, proactively managing expectations and collaborating on problem-solving.
* Contribute to the refinement of development/engineering methodologies and standards, anticipating potential issues and leading the resolution process.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

  

**Must-Have:**

  

* Skilled in full-stack application development with .NET C#, REST Api, React or any other typescript based UI frameworks, SQL databases
* Advanced knowledge of Azure services such as Azure app services, Azure Functions, Entra ID, Azure Foundry Services etc.
* Containerisation – Docker, Azure container apps, Azure Kubernetes Services (AKS)
* No-SQL database such Cosmos or Mongo DB
* Working experience with source control such as git or TFVC
* CI/CD pipelines, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions etc both for code and infrastructure
* Working experience with AI Coding platforms such as GitHub copilot, Cursor, Claude or similar
* Generative AI application development with Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Agent Framework/ Semantic Kernel, MCP, and Vector databases like Azure AI search, Postgres, etc.
* Understanding of various types of Large Language Models (LLMs)
* Fundamental understanding of Retrieval Augment Generation (RAG) techniques
* Fundamental understanding of classical AI/ML
* Skilled in Advanced prompt engineering

  

**Nice-to-Have:**

  

* Working knowledge about various AI Agents/ Agentic workflow and multi-agent frameworks and SDKs
* Graph Database such as Neo4j
* Experience with M365 Copilot Studio
* Microsoft Azure AI-900/ AI-102 Certification

  

**Behavioural Skills:**

  

* Excellent learning ability.
* Strong communication skill.
* Flexibility to work both independently and as part of a larger team.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
* The ability to adapt your work style to work with both internal and client team members.

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

  

* Bachelor’s / master’s degree in software engineering / information technology / BE/ B.TECH
* An overall 5 – 10 years of experience.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: System Integration Advisor
description:
**India T Special Bonus:**  
**Req ID:** 389897
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a System Integration Advisor to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
**Role:** AI Dev Engineer
  
  
Position Details
  

* Role: AI Dev Engineer
* Grade: Grade 10
* Experience Required: 5+ Years

Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a highly skilled Python Full Stack Developer to join our AI Automation Team. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing scalable full stack applications integrated with AI-driven solutions. The role requires strong expertise in backend and frontend development along with hands-on exposure to AI implementation projects and intelligent automation solutions.
  
  
The ideal candidate should be capable of collaborating with QA, Automation, Product, and AI Engineering teams to build innovative AI-enabled platforms and automation solutions for enterprise applications.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable full stack applications using Python-based technologies.
* Develop and integrate AI-powered features and automation capabilities into enterprise applications.
* Collaborate with AI Engineers, QA teams, Product Owners, and Architects to understand business problems and implement technical solutions.
* Build RESTful APIs, backend services, and frontend interfaces for AI-enabled platforms.
* Participate in solution design, technical discussions, and architecture reviews.
* Implement secure, high-performance, and reusable code following best engineering practices.
* Work on AI integration use cases such as intelligent automation, chatbot integration, recommendation engines, predictive analytics, or GenAI-based solutions.
* Perform unit testing, debugging, optimization, and production support activities.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and cloud-based application delivery.
* Ensure scalability, maintainability, and performance of developed applications.

Required Skills Qualifications
  

* 5+ years of hands-on experience in Python Full Stack Development.
* Strong expertise in Python frameworks such as Flask, FastAPI, or Django.
* Experience in frontend technologies such as React.js, Angular, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
* Hands-on experience in at least one AI implementation project.
* Experience implementing AI solutions within enterprise applications.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, microservices architecture, and backend integrations.
* Knowledge of databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or similar technologies.
* Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices.
* Understanding of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
* Good problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

Preferred Skills
  

* Experience with Generative AI, LLM integrations, or AI automation frameworks.
* Exposure to AI/ML libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, LangChain, or OpenAI APIs.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.
* Knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience with automation platforms and intelligent workflow solutions.

Educational Qualification
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.

Key Competencies
  

* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Ability to work in cross-functional teams.
* Solution-oriented mindset with innovation focus.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to adapt to fast-changing AI technologies and business requirements.

About NTT DATA
  
  
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.
  
  
Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata.com, @nttdatafed.com and @talent.nttdataservices.com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us.

If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us. title: Lead Developer – Full Stack (React.js + Node.js)
description:
Location: **Noida**


Experience: **8 to 12 Years**


No. Of Openings: **1**


  
### **Job Description**

We are looking for a hands\-on Lead Dev / Tech Lead – Full Stack to lead an engineering workstream on a large enterprise platform. The platform is a React 18 \+ TypeScript SPA backed by Node.js micro\-services on Azure over a Snowflake data platform, with Azure Event Hub and Datadog observability.


This is a senior hands\-on role — roughly 60% coding and design, 40% technical leadership, code review and direct client interaction. The person must be able to own a workstream end to end without supervision.


Key Responsibilities:


* Own end\-to\-end technical delivery of assigned workstreams across frontend (React / TypeScript) and backend (Node.js on Azure) — from requirement walkthrough to production release.
* Translate business requirements from client product owners into technical designs, break them into sprint\-ready tasks and estimate them.
* Act as the review gate for the team: pull\-request reviews, enforcing coding guidelines, modular and scalable design, and low code complexity.
* Remain hands\-on — personally write production code for the hardest parts of each sprint.
* Design and build REST APIs on Azure (App Service or Azure Functions; the platform runs on Functions v4 with Node 22\) integrating Snowflake, Event Hub and third\-party systems.
* Mentor and grow a team of 4–6 developers; run onboarding and knowledge transfer for new joiners.
* Represent Impressico on client technical calls in US Eastern hours — daily connects, sprint demos, design walkthroughs and production\-issue calls — and hold technical credibility with the client architects.
* Work with DevOps and QA on Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, release readiness and production support; drive application errors and performance issues to closure using Datadog.
* Own technical documentation — architecture notes, API documentation and runbooks.


### **Job Specification**


8–12 years of software engineering experience, including at least 3 years in a lead or senior capacity on enterprise\-grade products.


* Deep hands\-on React.js (18\+) with TypeScript — hooks, component design, state management, re\-render and bundle performance optimisation. TanStack / React Query experience strongly preferred.
* Deep hands\-on Node.js — JavaScript / TypeScript, REST API design, async patterns, error handling, performance and memory behaviour.
* Hands\-on Microsoft Azure — building and deploying services on Azure App Service and/or Azure Functions, Azure DevOps pipelines, Entra ID / Azure AD authentication (MSAL), Key Vault and App Configuration.
* Strong SQL and data modelling — able to write and tune complex queries and stored procedures (Snowflake, SQL Server or Oracle).
* Solid software design grounding — modular and scalable architecture, low cyclomatic complexity.
* Git branching strategy, CI/CD and code review practised as a discipline.
* Unit\-testing discipline (Vitest / Jest on the JS stack, equivalent on the backend).
* Excellent spoken and written English — able to run technical discussions with US\-based stakeholders independently.
* Agile / Scrum delivery — sprint planning, estimation, demos.
* Use of AI\-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor).


### **Required Key Skills**

**Good to have**


* Event\-driven architecture on Azure.
* Working experience using Snowflake (pooled connections, stored procedures, warehouse cost awareness).
* Observability tooling — Datadog RUM / APM and structured logging, or equivalent (App Insights, ELK).
* API gateway exposure — Apigee or Azure API Management.
* Vite\-based build tooling and modular / feature\-first frontend architecture.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (Angular + Java)
description:
Lab49 is an award winning specialist consultancy that creates bespoke technology in partnership with the most important companies in finance.
We were founded in 2002 to bring Silicon Valley solutions to Wall Street’s door. Since then, we have worked on successive waves of technological change, including distributed computing, high\-speed automation, enterprise UX and digital distribution (for which Lab49 was among the first significant practices established on Wall Street), DevOps, cloud and data science.
Today, we are an established partner in financial markets, having delivered hundreds of projects for clients including all the world’s tier\-one investment banks and many of the largest buy\-side firms globally.
Being part of Lab49 means bringing your drive and creativity into an environment where your contributions will make immediate impact. Engineers will work in cross functional teams, consulting directly with our clients, shaping not only technical solutions to business problems but delivering them into production
### **What You’ll Be Doing**

* Partnering with our client to lead the design and build of user experiences using modern web development technologies. You will manage a team of UI engineers and collaborate with key contributors to deliver high\-quality software within client environments.
* Contribute to the Interactive Practice within Lab49 by sharing best practices and driving a culture of high\-quality UI engineering and modern development standards.
* Act as a hands\-on engineer and architect supporting initiatives from small features to complex systems. Lead projects, mentor teams, and collaborate with other practices to ensure successful delivery.
* Design and build full\-stack applications using Angular (primary) and Java technologies (secondary), ensuring scalable architecture, efficient APIs, and seamless integration between front\-end and backend services.
* Support backend development using Java (e.g., Spring/Spring Boot) to build and maintain RESTful services, business logic, and integrations with enterprise systems and databases.
* Partner with client stakeholders to build strong relationships, acting as a strategic technical advisor and helping expand long\-term engagements.
* Support business development efforts through solution design, client presentations, and contributing to proposals and industry engagement.
* Help develop strong management practices within the Engineering practice, supporting career growth and mentoring across the team.
### **Key Responsibilities**

* Develop responsive web applications using Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS.
* Build backend services and APIs using Java and Spring Boot.
* Design and integrate RESTful APIs with frontend components.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams in an Agile environment.
* Write clean, testable code and participate in code reviews and CI/CD processes.
### **Required Skills**

* 8\+ years of software development experience.
* Strong expertise in Angular (v10\+)
* Backend development experience with Java / Spring Boot.
* Experience with REST APIs, Git, and modern development practices.
### **Preferred**

* Experience with microservices, AWS and Terraform.
* Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes and containerized deployments.
* Experience in capital markets, financial markets/products, consulting is highly desirable.
* Experience with Claude Code and GitHub Copilot is a plus.
Why Lab49?

Lab49 is an established partner for most financial institutions on Wall Street. You will gain exposure into a variety of environments, business domains, technologies, and people. Your ability to bring drive and creativity to the role will be the key component to success at Lab49\. The broad and intense exposure to a variety of challenges accelerates your career growth, and Lab49’s structure is designed to enable you to learn and grow as an engineer and consultant.
Lab49/ION is committed to maintaining a supportive and inclusive environment for people with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We respect the varied identities, abilities, cultures, and traditions of the individuals who comprise our organization and recognize the value that different backgrounds and points of view bring to our business.
Lab49/ION adheres to an equal employment opportunity policy that prohibits discriminatory practices or harassment against applicants or employees based on any legally impermissible factor.

*We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.*
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
